mother_reference_strengths: The wordmark is one compact moving composition, not two independently typeset characters.
茶 is broader and more laterally active while 作 is narrower and more upright, creating controlled asymmetry rather than equal-box balance.
A mid-level bridge and a lower sweeping stroke create two integrated horizontal relationships across the pair; these feel generated by the glyph system, not pasted on.
Stroke mass alternates between blunt/heavy blocks and tapered directional strokes, producing tension and rhythm.
Negative space between 茶 and 作 forms active triangular/irregular shapes; it is designed, not leftover spacing.
Terminals and edges contain controlled irregularity and directional cuts; the texture supports the skeleton but is not the primary source of identity.

what_m02_lost: fine stroke-weight modulation and local taper
micro-asymmetry that prevents the vector from feeling flat or mechanically smoothed
surface richness; however this cannot be treated as a substitute for skeleton quality

best_current_skeleton.reason: M03 is the only tested correction the user said was better, while M02 remains the strongest fidelity anchor. M04/M06 are negative evidence.

gap_vector_best_current_to_mother.gap: M03 contours are too uniformly clean/flat; mother has directional, deliberately irregular terminals.
M03 preserves silhouette but loses some mother-specific thick-thin modulation and localized taper.
The mother bridge reads as a natural continuation of the glyph motion; vector needs more faithful attachment/taper rather than a larger positional move.
The mother lower sweep carries weight, lift and a distinctive terminal; current vector is cleaner but less alive.
Mother contains small angular and curvature imbalances that create authored energy; smoothing/regularization removed part of this.
